title: Scorpio Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Scorpio (October 23 – November 21) is the intense water sign ruled by Pluto and Mars. Deep, loyal and magnetic, Scorpio never does anything halfway.
personality: Scorpio sees beneath the surface. Private and perceptive, they read people quickly and value truth above everything. Their emotions are powerful, and so is their determination. Once a Scorpio commits to a goal or a person, they are all in. They forgive slowly but love fiercely.
love: Scorpio wants deep, honest and loyal love. They test trust slowly, but once they let someone in, the bond is intense and lasting. Betrayal is the one thing they find very hard to forgive.
career: Scorpio excels in research, psychology, investigation, medicine, finance, strategy and any role that needs focus and courage.
friendship: Scorpio has few close friends, but those friends get total loyalty and someone who will always tell them the truth.

faq.q: What is the Scorpio personality like?
faq.ans: Scorpio is intense, loyal, perceptive and very determined.

faq.q: Who is Scorpio most compatible with?
faq.ans: Scorpio often matches best with Cancer, Pisces and Virgo.

faq.q: What is the lucky day of Scorpio?
faq.ans: Tuesday is traditionally considered lucky for Scorpio.
